items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So, I appeared on the segment at the concert with The World's Greatest Jazz Band. And one of the selections I did was 'You're Driving Me Crazy,' with Bob Wilber on soprano sax; Ralph Sutton on piano, and Bob Haggard on bass.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Nice.

And, of course, this was at the time when they unveiled the bust of Louis Armstrong.

And, of course, the Newport Jazz Festival is another one of those festivals where they have lots of musicians, and you never know who you're going to wind up singing with, nor what's going to come out on an album if and when they release one.
